text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Troy.
source_text: You see Troy.

text: 你看见特洛伊。
source_text: 你看见特洛伊。

text: Congratulations, human. You've been selected to join an elite band of worshippers. Follow me.
source_text: Congratulations, human. You've been selected to join an elite band of worshippers. Follow me.

text: 恭喜你，人类。你已经被选加入精英礼拜者的队伍。跟我走。
source_text: 恭喜你，人类。你已经被选加入精英礼拜者的队伍。跟我走。

text: This wouldn't happen to have anything to do with the rumors of a supermutant army running amok?
source_text: This wouldn't happen to have anything to do with the rumors of a supermutant army running amok?

text: 这件事情难道和超级变种人大军抓狂的谣言没有关联？
source_text: 这件事情难道和超级变种人大军抓狂的谣言没有关联？

text: Where are we going?
source_text: Where are we going?

text: 我们去哪？
source_text: 我们去哪？

text: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
source_text: What are you waiting for? Let's go!

text: 你还在等什么？我们快走吧！
source_text: 你还在等什么？我们快走吧！

text: I don't think so.
source_text: I don't think so.

text: 我不这样认为。
source_text: 我不这样认为。

text: What's that terrible, disgusting corpse-like stench? Oh, it's you!
source_text: What's that terrible, disgusting corpse-like stench? Oh, it's you!

text: 这他妈是什么恶心的东西啊，一股尸体的恶臭。哦！你这个家伙！
source_text: 这他妈是什么恶心的东西啊，一股尸体的恶臭。哦！你这个家伙！

text: Ruh?
source_text: Ruh?

text: 啊?
source_text: 啊?

text: Follow me and you will find out. Or, to put it another way, follow me and live, fool!
source_text: Follow me and you will find out. Or, to put it another way, follow me and live, fool!

text: 跟我走就知道了。
source_text: 跟我走就知道了。

text: So if I don't go, I die? That doesn't sound very religious.
source_text: So if I don't go, I die? That doesn't sound very religious.

text: 如果我不去，我就得死？这听起来可不像宗教用语。
source_text: 如果我不去，我就得死？这听起来可不像宗教用语。

text: You've convinced me. Let's start hoofing!

text: 我信你了！我们走吧。
source_text: 我信你了！我们走吧。

text: I don't think so.

text: 我不这样认为。

text: Don't start what you can't finish, freak!
source_text: Don't start what you can't finish, freak!

text: 别逞能！怪胎！
source_text: 别逞能！怪胎！

text: Excellent!
source_text: Excellent!

text: 棒极了！
source_text: 棒极了！

text: You should not play games with Lady Jain or the Children.
source_text: You should not play games with Lady Jain or the Children.

text: 你不该跟简恩女士或她的卫兵玩花样。
source_text: 你不该跟简恩女士或她的卫兵玩花样。

text: You should not insult what you cannot kill. Now, shall you come with me and live, or do you wish to stay here and die?
source_text: You should not insult what you cannot kill. Now, shall you come with me and live, or do you wish to stay here and die?

text: 你不应该侮辱你打不过的人。现在，你要是不想死在这就跟我走。
source_text: 你不应该侮辱你打不过的人。现在，你要是不想死在这就跟我走。

text: I'm coming!
source_text: I'm coming!

text: 我来啦！
source_text: 我来啦！

text: Forget it.
source_text: Forget it.

text: 别在意。
source_text: 别在意。

text: Jeez, some mutants just can't take a joke!
source_text: Jeez, some mutants just can't take a joke!

text: 天哪！你们这些变种人真他妈没一点幽默感！
source_text: 天哪！你们这些变种人真他妈没一点幽默感！

text: If I keep smelling you, I'll drop dead anyway!

text: 如果我再闻你身上的味我就要死啦！
source_text: 如果我再闻你身上的味我就要死啦！

text: You stupid beast! Will you come or will you stay?

text: 你这个笨鳖！你到底走不走？

text: Uh . . . Come!

text: 呃……我来了！

text: Uh . . . Me stay!

text: 呃……我留下！

text: Do not plague me with indecision! What is your answer, human?

text: 别让你的磨蹭使我不快！告诉我你的答案，人类！
